title: An import made before W4 has no import record, so the real account's doubled statement (MG-01) can be neither seen nor undone: every month May–Oct reads twice its spending and income
detail: Copy account (the user's backup of 26 Nov). Money holds 395 entries: 393 from two CSV batches made 64 s apart on 31 Oct (194 rows with no payee, then 199 with payees; both 1 May – 30 Oct) and 2 Collection mirrors. 392 of the 393 imported rows share their day, amount and direction with a row of the other batch: it is November's MG-01 (a second import mapped differently is all 'new'), made before W4's identity existed. W4 fixed MG-01 and MG-05 for imports made since, but state.money has no 'imports' key at all, so: #/money/imports says 'No statement imported yet' (KOS.money.imports() = [] while importCounts() = {two batches: 194, 199}); Transactions shows no Source filter (no [data-ui=money.tx-source]) at mac and iPhone; there is no Undo or Replace for either batch; and the rows carry no identity or bank text. Measured: every month's outgoings are 1.94–2.23× one batch's and income exactly 2× (Oct 1.99/1.98), so Overview, Budgets, Month and year, By merchant and every Money goal read double on the real data. The only way out today is to delete ~194 entries one by one or by hand-picked Select (both batches are mostly 'Other', so no filter isolates one). Reproduced twice (eval at mac and iPhone, screenshots of Imports and Transactions).
rootCause: js/core/money.js:262-267 (normalise) reads m.imports only and back-fills nothing from stored tx.batch groups (comment :284 'a document saved before imports … reads as having none'); js/modules/moneyimp.js:450-455 importsView lists M.imports() only; js/modules/money.js:550-556 hides the Source select when imps is empty; js/core/money.js:1568 undoBatch could remove a legacy batch but nothing calls it for one. Origin: November MG-01/MG-05 fixed forward only by W4 (39c1794f).
fix: Back-fill an import record for each stored tx.batch with no record (from/to/n from its rows, file 'Imported before 16 Nov', format csv) in M.normalise or a one-off KOS.repairs entry (invariant 1a, checkpoint first), so the Imports page offers Undo for each; and have the Imports page flag two batches whose rows pair one-for-one by day, amount and direction ('looks like the same statement twice').

title: Money's Overview shows the first-run 'Nothing here yet · Add your first income' to an account with six months of entries, whenever the current month has none and there is no rule or pot
detail: Copy account: 395 entries from 1 May to 30 Oct, no recurring rule, no pot, nothing yet in November. #/money (mac and iPhone, 27 Nov) draws the whole first-visit page: '円 · First run · Nothing here yet', the three set-up steps (currency, month start, 'Add your first income', 'Import a statement', 'Set a budget') and a ghosted preview — no hero, no Next card, no By merchant/By week, nothing of October. The header still says 'November so far · 27 of 30 days'. A student who logs a statement once a month sees the onboarding again every month until the import, and is told to set up what is already set up. Reproduced twice (mac and iPhone screenshots; [data-ui=money.first-step] present, no hero).
rootCause: js/modules/money.js:182 — empty = !s.count && !M.rules().length && !M.pots().length, where s is the CURRENT period's summary (js/core/money.js:988-994, tally(cur)), so a month without entries reads as an account without any.
fix: Decide first-run on the whole store (any stored transaction, e.g. one cursor read of the date index, or M.importCounts/list limit 1), not the current month; an empty current month draws the normal Overview with its low-data states (invariant 76) and a 'Nothing yet this month · last entry 30 Oct' line.
